pages.title: Attacks and Charging
pages.text: Enter combat mode with its keybind (default Y). Tap attack for a normal hit; hold to charge. Holding attack and use together guards with supported weapons.$(br2)The circular crosshair meter shows the current charge. Golden Core cultivators may use Blast Qi (default G); see Qi Release and Fist Force.

pages.title: Footwork and combinations
pages.text: During combat, hold Backward and press Jump to backstep. The route needs solid ground; walls, ledges, immobilization and freezing prevent the step. Repeated steps require longer recovery, with at most three in a short burst.$(br2)Opening light hits push slightly; follow-up hits on the same foe keep them close. Heavy strikes create separation. Guarding or being disabled during startup cancels the pending strike and its outward Qi release.
